overallAssessment: The core mechanical decision loop of Intrilex (Points vs. Anchors vs. Scuttle vs. Counters) is strategically sound, deep, and asymmetric. Zero gameplay balance changes are warranted. All observed balance anomalies stem from implementation defects (IMPL-01 scoring riders, IMPL-12 counter class mapping, DEG-01 Sudden Death in Unrestricted) and one-ply AI policy evaluation bias.

policyArtifacts.description: Solo Wild Copy and K♠ Wild Sovereignty fall to the fallback default weight (~100), causing heuristic policies to ignore them almost completely (5.3% and 2.8% conversion).
Lack of future-turn lookahead or hand-retention modeling causes heuristic policies to burn counters on low-value initial targets (76.3% A-base conversion), zeroing latent threat value.
Aggressive flat scoring bonuses cause heuristic policies to over-activate 3-Red Ultra (97 activations in 100 matches) as a generic counter, heavily distorting effect resolution rates.

watchlist.hypothesis: +2 Mini-Turns and draw 1 with immunity to Base Ace counters provides unanswerable tempo acceleration.
watchlist.falsificationCriterion: Falsified if fixing IMPL-12 restores 38% Ace counter threat and balances conversion.

watchlist.hypothesis: Turn-1 21-point burst via Foundation bonus scoring Black Joker.

watchlist.hypothesis: Reachable via 4♠, 2♠, and K♠ (63.2% by 15 cards seen), enabling excessive board wipe consistency.
watchlist.falsificationCriterion: Falsified by robust Ace counterplay and symmetrical self-wipe cost.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: Policy over-activation of 2B2R Ultra leads to sub-optimal win rates due to hand quality dilution.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Policy suppressing early 2B2R achieves equal or higher win rate across 200 paired matches.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: Black Joker Board Lock functions primarily as an asymmetric snowball finisher when ahead.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Trailing players activating Board Lock win >= 45% of matches across 80 declarations.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: Playing 10♥ for Tempo Spike is only superior to scoring 10 points when converting to >= 10 points.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Scoring 10 points consistently yields higher win rate regardless of hand composition.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: Establishing 2 untapped ER Queens creates an unanswerable endgame lock.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Opponents breach the fortress in >= 40% of cases using 4 Row Clear, Total Clear, or ⭐2.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: 4♠ Total Clear functions primarily as a comeback equalizer rather than a snowball finisher.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Total Clear win rate is significantly higher when declared while ahead.

recommendedExperiments.hypothesis: Core Unrestricted preserves equal seat balance when Sudden Death and Super enumeration are fixed.
recommendedExperiments.falsificationCriterion: Seat 1 win rate falls outside [0.45, 0.55] with p < 0.01 across 576 matches.
